identifiedGaps.mechanism: src/lib/data/shop-routes.ts omits 'control-de-peso' from supplementCategoryBySlug, returning { type: 'not-found' }. src/lib/product-listing.ts omits productCategorySlug from supplementListingGroupsBySegment, returning empty baseProducts.
identifiedGaps.recommendedFix: Add 'control-de-peso' category to Prisma Category table, add to supplementCategoryBySlug in shop-routes.ts, and set productCategorySlug in product-listing.ts.

identifiedGaps.mechanism: In src/lib/data/shop-routes.ts, 'performance' is aliased to 'creatina-y-pre', but in src/lib/product-listing.ts, 'performance' has productCategorySlug: undefined, returning baseProducts: [].
identifiedGaps.recommendedFix: Create dedicated 'performance' category under Suplementos in DB and map properly across shop-routes.ts and product-listing.ts.

identifiedGaps.mechanism: src/lib/product-listing.ts filters subcategories using product.subcategorySlugs.includes(slug). The current catalog importer persists categories in ProductCategory join table but leaves Product.subcategorySlugs as empty array []. All subcategory listing pages consequently render 0 products or trigger notFound().
identifiedGaps.recommendedFix: Update backend catalog-import repository or mapper to automatically populate Product.subcategorySlugs from the assigned ProductCategory leaf slugs.

identifiedGaps.mechanism: Entreno uses Tiendanube suffixed slugs (shark1, entreno2, xbelt1, symmetry1, raw1) because brand slugs already existed. EntrenAR navigation.ts links to /indumentaria/shark, etc. Importing raw source slugs would cause 404.
identifiedGaps.recommendedFix: Map suffixed source slugs to clean unsuffixed slugs (shark, entreno, xbelt, symmetry, raw) under parent 'indumentaria'.

identifiedGaps.mechanism: Entreno URL slug is 'panqueques-mezclas', but visual navigation label and EntrenAR navigation.ts href is '/market/polvos-mezclas'.
identifiedGaps.recommendedFix: Map source slug 'panqueques-mezclas' to normalized slug 'polvos-mezclas'.

identifiedGaps.mechanism: Entreno URL slug is 'citrulina', but navigation menu and EntrenAR navigation.ts href is '/suplementos/pre-intra-creatina/pump-vasodilatadores'.
identifiedGaps.recommendedFix: Map source slug 'citrulina' to normalized slug 'pump-vasodilatadores'.

identifiedGaps.mechanism: backend/src/modules/catalog/catalog.mapper.ts determines product.categorySlug by picking categories[0] sorted alphabetically by category.id. A multi-category product (e.g. Shaker in Shakers and Proteínas) will have its primary category chosen arbitrarily based on CUID string order, hiding it from the other category's listing.
identifiedGaps.recommendedFix: In PRD2, establish deterministic primary category selection rules (e.g. parent category preference or explicit hierarchy-derived primary flag).
